clock: All native ticks, AR/R inputs, window and control inputs are actual MIG ui_clk. Source clock ticks are separate; never subtract domains.

read_interface.request: rd_req_i and rd_index_i sampled on UI rising edge
read_interface.response: rd_valid_o with corresponding rd_data_o after two registered UI stages
read_interface.stability: Read frozen rows/log after capture; unused log words have no evidence meaning

controls.epoch_start_i: One-time after true MIG aresetn reset release; requires known_empty_i && !ARfire && !RVALID. May start with calibrated_i=0 so the first calibrated AR is tracked. Later pulse invalid; never clears ledger.
controls.known_empty_i: External true-MIG aresetn reset-release empty certificate established before first accepted read; idle cycles, waiting for calibration or ARM are not proof.
controls.epoch_i: 32-bit epoch identity, stable throughout tracking; change invalidates.
controls.arm_i: One UI pulse begins a new capture; preserves all outstanding accepted reads, ordinal, perRID occurrence and sticky tracking errors. ARM while prior nonfrozen capture or window high invalidates.
controls.window_i: Already synchronized UI level. Fixed window is [UI first-high edge, first-low edge). Record exact UI open/close and separately source boundaries/CDC offset. Selection uses current high value and does not depend on K.
controls.ar_eligible_i: Same UI-cycle predicate for accepted candidate PTE (e.g. conditional fullID48). Only screening, not an owner proof; root must prove native PTW owner/tuple chain.
controls.abort_i: Freezes incomplete result with error bit13.
controls.external_loss_i: Sticky invalid bit9 for source/CDC/ownership observer loss.
controls.selected_toggle_o: Toggles once on first eligible P ARaccept; ARM does not toggle. Source can synchronize and freeze its recent owner ring.
controls.calibrated_i: Track before calibration; first high sets calibration_seen. A later low, any ARfire/RVALID while low, or ARM while low invalidates with error1. First high edge may simultaneously accept AR and it is fully tracked.

header_words.4: current_tick while capturing; freeze_tick once frozen
header_words.9: global_ARaccepted count, frozen copy after freeze
header_words.10: global_Rfire count, frozen copy after freeze
header_words.11: complete-window eligible ARaccept count (continues after selected episode)

status_bits.5: episode_done (P and all snapshot predecessors retired)

error_bits.1: epoch changed, calibration lost after first high, ARfire/RVALID before calibration, or ARM before calibration
error_bits.2: unmatched R or return contrary to bound MIG global FIFO head
error_bits.3: RLAST disagrees with remaining_beats==1 (checked also while held)
error_bits.7: held ARVALID tuple changed or VALID dropped
error_bits.8: held RVALID payload/RID/LAST/RESP changed or VALID dropped
error_bits.10: ARM while window high or previous capture not frozen
error_bits.12: Rfire log capacity or 19-bit preceding-held run overflow; no backpressure

predecessor_rows.selection: all live slots immediately before Paccept, including a predecessor retired by Rfire on the same edge; already-retired predecessors have zero debt by continuous tracking and are not stored

row_words.4: final Rfire tick in synchronous completion RAM; meaningful only completed frozen row
row_words.5: lifetime held R cycles in completion RAM, includes preP carry; meaningful only completed frozen row
row_words.6: associated Rfire count strictly after the Paccept edge

R_event_log.selection: every RVALID UI edge from Paccept INCLUDING that edge until P and all snapshot predecessors retire; includes held edges and unrelated RID responses during this episode; log continues after window close if needed
R_event_log.loss: One record per Rfire, preceded by exact consecutive held count. Reconstruct [fire_tick-held_count, fire_tick) as held RVALID cycles, clipped to P acceptance. No-valid gaps remain distinct. Any overflow invalidates without AXI backpressure.

debt_semantics: Process Rfire first using preedge fullRID FIFO head, decrement ARLEN+1 remaining, then snapshot all predecessor slots. P itself excluded. Same-edge final predecessor is retained with k=0 and completed=true.
identity_limit: FullRID is not job identity. Root must uniquely join P and each positive-debt predecessor tuple/ordinal with actual source PTW/TL/DMA owner/generation; unknown/ambiguous association invalidates causal record.

resources_estimate_only.notes: Completed time/held fields stored in32x128 synchronous RAM instead of broadcast per-slot registers; unchanged frozen v2 dump ABI. All protocol errors remain invalid even though accounting may advance by observed FIFO head/LAST.

not_hardware_validation: Unit tests and lint only; no actual MIG capture/build/load claimed by this seat.
implementation_scope: Root implementation binds checked global FIFO return order of exact generated MIG4.2/NORM; contrary RID/head order invalidates, never treated as zero debt. Not generic out-of-order AXI.
